title: Mheibes
tagline: Read the faces and find the fist that hides the ring.
description: Mheibes is a traditional ring-hunting game of Iraq and the Gulf. A ring is hidden in one of ten closed fists held by five players; you stare at faces, open the fists that look empty and name the hand that holds it, then swap sides and try to fool the other team. Every player has a personality that stays the same through the match: learn who to believe. Three computer levels, two players on one phone, four hands-on lessons, hints, and a Watch & Learn mode with Pause. Counters are only a score. Large text, reduced motion, works offline.
howToPlay: New here? Tap Learn to play: four short hands-on lessons.
Seeking: tap a face to stare at that player and watch for a tell.
Tap a fist, then press Bat to open it (empty is out, the ring ends the round) or Bas to name it as the ring.
Open more empty fists before you answer for a bigger score, but each open is a small risk.
Hiding: tap the fist that will hold the ring, then pick a performer to bluff the other team.
Every player has a personality that stays the same for the whole match: after each round the game shows who was who.
Hint explains a good move. Auto Play shows the computer playing a whole match, with Pause.
Settings: three computer levels, rounds in a match, carpets, sound and reduced motion.
